content.description: The Lucid Dream NFT purpose is to raise awareness about Mental Health, more specifically Addiction in the Digital Age. Each one of our NFT drops are based on a digital addiction and split into two phases : Addicted and Tamed. Addicted : A Series of NFTs that depict our daily habits when interacting with our addiction, unaware of our toxic actions. Tamed : A Series of NFTs that remind us that small habits can help us overcome such toxic behaviors.
